messages:
maya: Dropping a new Figma for the API Keys panel. Need quick UX + a11y sanity check for rotate/revoke, empty state, and copy flows: https://figma.com/file/ghi789 (placeholder)
eli: Primary CTA currently says `Rotate`. Make it explicit: `Rotate key` or `Rotate this key` so context is clear in lists.
jordan: Add a small `Used by X apps` line under each key. Also a `View usage` button opening a drawer before destructive actions.
sam: Impl note: modal traps focus now, but after rotation we should move focus to the success panel's `Copy new key` button and start a timer to auto-hide the key.
nora: A11y: announce success via aria-live="polite": "New API key generated. Use the reveal button to view it." Do not read out full key by default.
maya: Timer length? Mobile copy is flaky. Proposing 20s visible time + visible helper text: `This is the only time the full key will be shown.`
eli: Toast copy: prefer full sentence `API key copied to clipboard.` for clarity and screen readers. Ensure copy button has accessible name `Copy new API key`.
sam: Backend flag resp.one_time_key available. Front snippet: `if (resp.one_time_key) { showOneTimeKey(resp.key); startTimer(20000); }`. Also consider 500ms press-to-reveal on mobile to avoid shoulder-surf.
jordan: Revoke flow: require typed confirmation or checkbox if key is used by >=3 apps. Show undo snackbar for 30s after revoke.
nora: Visuals: don't rely on color for danger. Add icon + aria-label `Confirm revoke API key`. Ensure contrast AA.
maya: Empty state wording: instead of `You have no API keys yet.` try `No API keys yet — create one to start using the API` with CTA `Create key` and a small `How keys work` link.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 02:00 UTC (automated:deploy)
maya: Thanks — I'll update Figma with ARIA notes, focus targets, and the usage drawer, then file KEYUX-423 for implementation.
